summary_markdown:
A monitoring view (`v_ch_box_linked`) was updated to improve data visibility. The view joins box, company, and facility tables to determine the operational status (ACTIVE, DISABLED, STOCK) of advertising units.

Discussion confirmed that the target system does not cache views created in PostgreSQL when accessed via ClickHouse, ensuring real-time data retrieval.
decisions: The monitoring view `v_ch_box_linked` was updated and deployed.
